title: Gemini 3 Release
summary: Google announced the release of Gemini 3 on November 18, 2025, beginning the Gemini 3 era with Gemini 3 Pro in preview and availability across Google products and developer platforms.
significance: A dated public release milestone in Google's Gemini model family.

verification.note: Google's first-party November 18, 2025 announcement explicitly states that Google was releasing Gemini 3, beginning with Gemini 3 Pro in preview, and making it available that day across the Gemini app, AI Mode in Search, AI Studio, Vertex AI, Gemini CLI, and Google Antigravity. The candidate records only that directly supported public release milestone. No development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, or relationship edges are inferred.
